description: Arugan wears an olive-grey textured wrap coat with gold scrolling embroidered borders and pale fur edging at collar, sleeve ends and hem, cream patterned under-sleeves, a brown woven patterned sash with hanging end and silver-toned pendant tassels, loose dark patterned trousers and tall brown boots. Both hands hang visibly at his sides, with the entire opaque layered outfit and ground visible.
